id: \bI would give you something for visiting me but I seem to have misplaced it.
en: \bI would give you something for visiting me but I seem to have misplaced it.
it: \bTi darei qualcosa per essere passato a trovarmi, ma a quanto pare l'ho perso.

id: \bI found what I was looking for. Here, take this.
en: \bI found what I was looking for. Here, take this.
it: \bHo trovato quello che cercavo. Ecco, prendi.

id: \bThat's a ticket that will take let you board a ship in Vermillion City.
en: \bThat's a ticket that will take let you board a ship in Vermillion City.
it: \bÈ un biglietto che ti permetterà di imbarcarti su una nave ad Aranciopoli.
